components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: stretch; height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; background: rgb(var(--paper, 238 240 236) / 0.9); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(var(--rule, 12 18 15) / 0.9); font-family: Grotesk, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 300; color: rgb(var(--ink, 12 18 15)); } .ds-nav-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding-right: 24px; border-right: 1px solid rgb(var(--rule, 12 18 15) / 0.18); color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-tag-part { background: rgb(var(--ink, 12 18 15)); color: rgb(var(--paper, 238 240 236)); padding: 2px 6px; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; align-items: stretch; } .ds-nav-links a { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 14px; font-size: 0.95rem; color: rgb(var(--muted, 74 84 79)); text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms; } .ds-nav-links a:hover { color: rgb(var(--ink, 12 18 15)); } .ds-nav-links a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 12px; right: 12px; bottom: -1px; height: 3px; background: rgb(var(--signal, 0 219 130)); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-links a[aria-current='true'] { color: rgb(var(--ink, 12 18 15)); font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav-links a[aria-current='true']::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-links a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--signal, 0 219 130)); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-figure { margin: 0; font-family: Grotesk, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-grid { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--rule, 12 18 15) / 0.18); background-color: rgb(var(--sheet, 248 249 246)); background-image: linear-gradient(rgb(var(--grid, 12 18 15) / 0.07) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(var(--grid, 12 18 15) / 0.07) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(rgb(var(--grid, 12 18 15) / 0.035) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(var(--grid, 12 18 15) / 0.035) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 48px 48px, 48px 48px, 12px 12px, 12px 12px; background-position: -1px -1px; } .ds-shot { width: 100%; height: 100%; background: rgb(var(--paper, 238 240 236)); border: 1px solid rgb(var(--rule, 12 18 15) / 0.9); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -16px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55); transition: transform 500ms; } .ds-figure:hover .ds-shot { transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-figure figcaption { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 300; color: rgb(var(--muted, 74 84 79)); }

components.css: .ds-trace { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: Grotesk, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(var(--ink, 12 18 15)); } .ds-trace li { position: relative; padding: 0 0 32px 40px; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-trace li:last-child { padding-bottom: 0; } .ds-trace h3 { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-seg { position: absolute; left: 7px; top: 0.5rem; bottom: -0.5rem; width: 3px; background: rgb(var(--signal, 0 219 130)); transform-origin: top; transition: transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-trace:hover .ds-seg { transform: scaleY(1); } .ds-node { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0.2rem; width: 17px; height: 17px; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 999px; border: 3px solid rgb(var(--signal, 0 219 130)); background: rgb(var(--paper, 238 240 236)); z-index: 1; } .ds-node-on { background: rgb(var(--signal, 0 219 130)); }

narrative.overview:
The person is documented the way an electronic part is documented: a part number, a revision, spec tables, a package drawing, a pin configuration, a revision history and ordering information. Every surface reads as a printed technical sheet. In light mode it is cool off-white paper with black ink; in dark mode the same sheet sits under a lightbox as a deep green-black blueprint. Nothing is decorative unless a datasheet would carry it: rules, ticks, dimension lines, figure captions, an engineering grid behind drawings.

Density is that of a reference document, not a marketing page. Content lives in tables and ruled lists separated by 1px hairlines; heavier rules close sections. A single signal green does the work a highlighter does on a printout: it marks traces, pins, the active state and the one primary action, and it is never a background wash. Type is one grotesque in two weights, with tabular numerals throughout, so the page has the evenness of a typeset spec.

The confirmed rejection is the stock developer portfolio: split hero with floating card grid, rounded cards, and pill clouds of technologies.
keyCharacteristics: Printed-sheet frame: header strip with part number and revision, footer with "sheet" pagination.
Akzidenz-Grotesk only, weights 300 and 700, tabular numerals.
Hairline (18% ink) and strong (90% ink) 1px rules carry all structure.
One signal green for traces, pins, markers, active states and the primary action.
Square corners everywhere; circles only where a drawn part is circular.
Drafting grid (48px major, 12px minor) behind every figure.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Green is the only hue. It marks something live (a trace, a pin, an active state, the action to take) and never fills a section, card or large background.

rules.name: The Legible Green Rule
rules.body: Signal Green (#00db82) is never used as text or thin line-art on light paper; anything that must be read uses Trace Ink Green.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Only 300 and 700 exist. Light is the default for everything; bold names things (part name, titles, spec values, active nav, buttons).

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Tracking tightens as size grows: -0.035em at display, -0.03em at headline, -0.02em at title, none at body.

rules.name: The Ruled Row Rule
rules.body: Lists and tables open on a strong rule and separate rows with hairlines. A new grouping is a new rule, not a new card.

rules.name: The Paper-Flat Rule
rules.body: Containers, sections, tables and buttons at rest carry no shadow. A shadow means "an object placed on the drawing", never "a card".

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: No radius on any UI surface. A circle is allowed only when it depicts a circular part on a drawing.

dos: **Do** build every new grouping as a ruled list or spec table: strong rule on top, hairline between rows.
**Do** use Signal Green (#00db82) only for something live: a trace, pin, marker, active state or the single primary action.
**Do** set any green text or thin green line on light paper in Trace Ink Green (#007444).
**Do** keep type to Grotesk at 300 and 700 with tabular numerals, tightening tracking as size grows.
**Do** put screenshots and drawings on a drafting-grid figure with a "Fig. N" caption.
**Do** keep the 76rem sheet column and the 4/8 sticky-title split for standard sections.
**Do** honor reduced motion: the trace is drawn, hover lifts are removed.
donts: **Don't** use rounded cards or pill chips; corners are 0px and technologies are listed as text or pins.
**Don't** introduce a second accent hue or a green background wash.
**Don't** add shadows to containers, sections or buttons at rest.
**Don't** add a third font weight or a second family.
**Don't** place small uppercase eyebrow labels above section titles; the headline stands alone with its intro.
